newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tak Wing says unit barred from tenders.
newsitem.headline: Tak Wing says unit barred from tenders.

text.p: Civil engineering group Tak Wing Investment (Holdings) Ltd said on Thursday its wholly-owned Wan Hin and Co Ltd unit was suspended from tendering for new work and maintenance contracts for Hong Kong's Housing Authority.
"Wan Hin had been suspended for a period of six months...The suspension is retrospective with effect from 1 December 1996," Tak Wing said in a statement.
The company said it believed the suspension in new work tenders was due to delays in the completion of the only new work in which it was involved.
It said it believed Wan Hin was suspended from tendering for maintenance contracts because it did not submit tenders for some recent contracts for which it had been invited to tender.
The company said it has appealed against the suspension.
Tak Wing said the suspension should not have an affect on its profitability.
